why: Business-growth and money-making education: Meta 'unrealistic outcomes' policy and the FTC's proposed Business and Money-Making Opportunity Rule.
never: get rich quick, overnight, in X days
passive income, financial freedom, quit your job
screenshots of earnings or bank balances
specific earnings for a typical buyer
allowed: Story-based results of fictional characters (Tony) clearly in a cartoon
Process outcomes (more members, fewer scattered leads) without money amounts
Verified public facts with a source in facts.json
Numbers about the market (ad costs, reach) with a source
numbers_rule: Any number about a client's result must come from proof.json with permission and evidence. Otherwise remove it.
ad_disclaimer: Results vary. We don't promise any income or business result.
fictional_note: Tony and Dex are fictional characters.
